note: Landsbankinn's price list (25 August 2026), read in full for its personal credit cards on 2026-10-30: the general credit card (3,700 kronur a year), Gold card collecting Aukakrónur (14,400), Gold Vildarkort (14,400), Platinum card (24,900), Platinum Vildarkort (24,900) and Premium Vildarkort (44,000); the general card with gold travel insurance (6,900) is being phased out and takes no new applications, so it isn't written. Each: a balance spread over longer payments bears 15.70% a year, the one credit card rate in Landsbankinn's interest rate chart of 1 September 2026 (read 2026-10-29); a cash withdrawal on the card at a machine or bank in Iceland costs 2.20% plus the 120-krone withdrawal fee (2.75% abroad, at least 800 kronur, not written); the bank adds 2.30% to the wholesale VISA rate on every foreign card transaction; each statement paid by debit from an account costs 120 kronur, written as a monthly fee (120 kronur a month assumes one statement a month; paying by payment slip costs 300, not written); and a collection warning on a missed payment costs 950 kronur, written as the late fee. The 250-krone transaction fee for spreading a card payment and the limit-raise fees aren't written. The main banks: Landsbankinn, Arion banki and Íslandsbanki; only Landsbankinn, the largest, is written, the others' price lists not reached on 2026-10-30. Arion banki, Iceland's second large bank, was added in wave 4: its general price list for individuals (in force from 7 May 2026), section 12, credit cards, and its interest rate table (14 October 2026), read 2026-10-30. The VISA cards' yearly fees: the general card 3,990 kronur, the Blue card 5,490 (free to those 23 and younger, not written), Gold 12,360, Gold Vildarkort 15,360, Platinum 21,480, Platinum Vildarkort 26,280, Premium World 52,375 and Premía 60,970 (the list's column for 16 December 2026 lowers the last two to 49,875 and 58,470, not yet in force); payment spreading and the revolving balance bear 15.75% a year; a cash withdrawal at a machine in Iceland costs 2.20% plus 130 kronur (2.75%, at least 820, abroad, not written); the bank adds 2.70% to the VISA wholesale rate on foreign-currency transactions; each electronic statement debited from an account costs 130 kronur, written as a monthly fee as Landsbankinn's is; a collection warning costs 950 kronur, written as the late fee. The online-only Netkort and the discounts for Arion fríðindi customers aren't written, nor the payment-spreading set-up and transaction fees. Íslandsbanki's price list page carries a captcha and wasn't read. The minimum payment: a card's bill is due in full unless the holder spreads it; Arion banki's payment-spreading page (read 2026-10-30) says the least to pay is 10% of the bill, written as 10% on its eight cards; the 30,000-krona least sum it also states is read as the smallest bill that can be spread and isn't modelled. No minimum payment is published for Landsbankinn's six cards; tried: its price list and interest chart (none stated), its card pages (they answered 404 behind a captcha, not circumvented), a search in Icelandic for its spreading minimum (a comparison site, not a source, said it isn't published), and archive.org's availability API (its snapshots can't be read: web.archive.org is refused by this environment's egress), which lists no snapshot of its card page.
